What underwriting evidence assembly costs is usually known only as a feeling. Turning that feeling into a signed number is the opening move; the engineering follows the evidence, never the other way round.
What the operations floor feels every week
the recurring pressure points, Life & Annuities edition:

items: APS records, paramedical data and financial underwriting arrive as documents; assembly consumes days per case.
Valuation and experience studies assemble from extracts with manual reconciliation; regime changes (IFRS 17) expose the debt.
Surrender, loan and beneficiary transactions route through document-heavy queues with abandonment risk.
Lapse and mortality experience signals arrive late; retention and repricing actions lag.

blocks.x: In Life & Annuities, the pattern is lapse-signal models — payment and engagement signals predicting lapse with action policy. Retention actions timely sits on top as the measured result, tracked from the signed baseline onward. Around it, we build the assistants, classifiers and retrieval systems that carry the decision, then hold them to an eval set your reviewers recognize as their own.

The underwriting evidence assembly cadence is short: weeks one and two set the signed baseline, weeks three through eight produce a working slice (Lapse-signal models), and the gate review decides what scales — all inside one quarter in Life & Annuities. The discipline is the differentiator — measured baselines, bounded scopes, and decisions you can replay a year later. For Life & Annuities, that discipline is not optional — it is the engagement model.
What the regime expects of you

Two regimes anchor the Applied AI & GenAI frame in Life & Annuities: IFRS 17 / LDTI — actuarial data and reporting discipline; GLBA/privacy regimes — health and financial data duties. By the time the regulator asks, the evidence already exists — that is the point of designing controls first.
